title: 日常行程
description: 描述每日生活作息與安排

sentences.en: I usually wake up at seven o'clock.
The first thing I do is brush my teeth.
sentences.zh: 我做的第一件事是刷牙。

sentences.en: I take a shower every morning.
I have breakfast before I leave for work.
sentences.zh: 我出門上班前會吃早餐。

sentences.en: I commute to work by subway.
I start work at nine in the morning.
I usually have lunch around noon.
sentences.zh: 我通常中午左右吃午餐。

sentences.en: I take a short nap after lunch.
I finish work at six in the evening.
After work, I go to the gym.
I cook dinner at home most days.
sentences.zh: 我大部分時候在家煮晚餐。

sentences.en: I watch TV for an hour before bed.
I usually go to bed around eleven.
sentences.zh: 我通常十一點左右上床睡覺。

sentences.en: I check my phone first thing in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我早上第一件事是看手機。

sentences.en: I make coffee as soon as I get up.
I drop the kids off at school on my way to work.
sentences.zh: 我上班途中送小孩去學校。

sentences.en: I spend about an hour commuting every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天花大約一小時通勤。

sentences.en: I have a meeting every Monday morning.
I pick up groceries on my way home.
sentences.zh: 我回家路上會順便買菜。

sentences.en: I walk my dog every evening.
I read for a while before going to sleep.
On weekends, I like to sleep in.
sentences.zh: 週末的時候，我喜歡睡晚一點。

sentences.en: I do laundry twice a week.
I set my alarm for six thirty.
I get dressed and head out the door.
I eat out with my colleagues sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我有時候和同事一起外出用餐。

sentences.en: I try to exercise at least three times a week.
sentences.zh: 我盡量一週至少運動三次。

sentences.en: I spend my evenings relaxing at home.
I prepare my clothes the night before.
sentences.zh: 我前一晚會準備好衣服。

sentences.en: My morning routine takes about forty minutes.
sentences.zh: 我的早晨日常大約花四十分鐘。
